workflows.title_hint: 4.3  Fuselage Skin Crack — Field Repair Procedure
workflows.summary: 4.3  Fuselage Skin Crack — Field Repair Procedure: Operator performs: inspect the crack → remove the damaged material → grind the surrounding surface → preheat the component → apply multiple weld passes → cool component → perform ultrasonic testing to confirm weld integrity → perform a stress relief heat treatment cycle
sections: 4.3  Fuselage Skin Crack — Field Repair Procedure

workflows.summary: 4.4  Landing Gear Bolt Torque Verification: Torque values performs: remove the access panel → inspect each bolt → clean the bolt threads → apply torque → mark the bolt head → reinstall the access panel → exceed the limits specified in Table 4.4

4.5  Engine Mount Bracket Weld Repair: Operator performs: inspect the crack region → remove the damaged material → grind the surface → preheat the bracket → apply weld passes per the engine mount repair specification → perform dye penetrant testing to confirm crack closure → perform a localized stress relief treatment

4.6  Cabin Window Seal Replacement: Operator performs: remove the interior window trim panel → extract the old seal using a plastic trim tool → clean the seal channel of adhesive residue → apply new adhesive primer → install the replacement seal → reinstall the trim panel → use metal tools
